desc_zh: 可单独采购展示架硬件、替换印刷画面，或选择完整展示套装。
desc_en: Choose stand hardware, replacement printed graphics, or a complete roll-up display kit.

detail_zh.lead: 易拉宝是一种可卷收画面的便携式展示形式，适合需要快速布置和重复使用的室内宣传场景。可根据项目需要单独采购展示架硬件、替换画面，或组合成完整套装。
highlights: 可单独供应展示架硬件
可单独制作替换印刷画面
可按项目需求组合硬件与画面套装
具体结构、规格及配件以选定款式确认为准
applications: 接待区、会议及室内宣传
delivery: 展示架硬件与印刷画面可按订单分别包装
完整套装按确认的组合方式交付
包装方式及运输费用根据订单和目的地核算
detail_zh.artwork: 可提供已完成的印刷文件；文件尺寸和出血要求需与选定画面规格核对。基础文件检查和简单调整可协助处理，复杂修改或原创设计另行确认。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供展示用途、所需数量、是否需要硬件/替换画面/完整套装、画面尺寸或参考款式、设计文件及交付目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 不同款式的底座结构、支撑杆、画面尺寸和配件可能不同。下单前需确认具体款式及画面适配关系；未确认前不承诺通用互换。

detail_en.lead: A roll-up banner is a portable display format with a graphic that retracts into its base. It is suited to indoor promotions that need quick setup and repeat use. Hardware, replacement graphics, or a complete kit can be supplied according to the project.
highlights: Stand hardware can be supplied separately
Replacement printed graphics can be produced separately
Hardware and graphic can be combined as a complete kit
Exact construction, specifications and accessories depend on the selected model
applications: Reception areas, meetings and indoor promotions
finishing: Hardware and graphic supplied as a coordinated set
delivery: Hardware and printed graphics may be packed separately by order
Complete kits are supplied in the confirmed configuration
Packing and freight are assessed for the order and destination
detail_en.artwork: You may supply print-ready artwork. File dimensions and bleed should be checked against the selected graphic size. Basic file checks and minor adjustments can be assisted; extensive changes or original design are confirmed separately.
detail_en.brief: Please specify the intended use, quantity, whether you need hardware, a replacement graphic or a complete kit, the graphic size or a reference model, artwork and destination.
detail_en.caveat: Base construction, support poles, graphic dimensions and accessories vary by model. Confirm the selected model and graphic compatibility before ordering; universal interchangeability is not assumed.

seo_description_zh: 提供易拉宝展示架硬件、替换印刷画面或完整套装，具体规格按选定款式确认。
seo_description_en: Trade supply of roll-up banner stand hardware, replacement printed graphics and complete display kits. Specifications depend on the selected model.
